note: Thrust curves bundled with Mises. Every file is a RASP .eng simfile from ThrustCurve.org whose license class there is Public Domain ('PD'), as recorded per simfile in ThrustCurve's data (mirrored in the OpenRocket motor-database, https://github.com/openrocket/motor-database, thrust_curves.license). Files are unmodified. Curves whose ThrustCurve license is not PD (e.g. AeroTech F39T, F42T, F52T, G64W, Estes F15) are NOT bundled; the PD Estes C6 user file was left out because its curve integrates to 10.0 Ns against the 8.82 Ns certified total. Every bundled curve integrates within 3% of ThrustCurve's listed total impulse (tests/rocketry). Unbundled curves: rocket_motor fetches them at runtime into the user's home, or the agent passes the .eng text it opened on thrustcurve.org.
